name: Nagykozár (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagykozár (a quartered shield of red and blue with a ploughshare, a swan, a fleur-de-lis and the figures 17 and 96) below the name NAGYKOZÁR in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
